description: Expected value of a scholarship application (award times win probability, clamped to 0 to 100 percent) and its expected value per hour of work, with the page verdict comparing that rate with an hourly wage. Use when the user weighs whether a scholarship application is worth the time, or ranks several by expected value. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive Scholarship ROI Tracker calculator.
